Metadata.title: Time Picker
Metadata.description: Find a time that works for everyone.

Home.heading: Find a time everyone loves.
Home.lead: Propose a handful of dates, share the poll, and let your group pick the one that works. No more endless back-and-forth.
Home.feature1Body: Pick every date that could work on a friendly, multi-month calendar.
Home.feature2Body: Send a link to everyone you're trying to schedule with. No sign-up needed.
Home.feature3Body: Watch responses roll in and spot the date that works for the whole group.
Home.ctaHeading: Ready to lock in a date?
Home.ctaBody: Create a poll in under a minute.
